emotion-distilroberta.note: 7-way Ekman emotions, DistilRoBERTa. Closest in size to our baseline.

goemotions-roberta.note: 28-way GoEmotions, RoBERTa-base. The finest-grained fold available.

xlmr-sentiment.note: 3-way sentiment, XLM-R. Multilingual, but cannot express the Hesitant/Frustrated split that the whole tone scheme exists for.

xlm-emo.note: 4-way multilingual emotion, XLM-R. The multilingual option that still has an emotion label space.
